trust_decision.summary: Stored, staff-supplied data (helpdesk SavedSearch.query posted to save_query, and the import recap file in default_storage) is deserialized server-side; the fix decides the data must be JSON (not pickle) and validates the saved query's keys in SavedSearchForm before it is stored.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'pickle deserialization'; run_report's saved-query load is where the pickle.loads was (fix.diff:170). At the pinned commit it is already json, so an engineer then moves to save_query at tendenci/apps/helpdesk/views/staff.py:1223, which stores query_encoded with no validation.

fix_sites.entry_point: new SavedSearchForm used by save_query (fix.diff:31-51); no form exists at the pinned commit

fix_sites.module_kind: legacy HTTP view in a separate app
legacy HTTP view in a separate app

fix_sites.entry_point: GET /helpdesk/reports/<report>/?saved_query=<id> (tendenci/apps/helpdesk/urls.py:116-118); this fix commit IS the pinned commit, so it is already applied

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: tendenci/apps/imports/views.py:134 and tendenci/apps/imports/views.py:199 (old user import flow; user_upload_add just redirects to profiles.user_import at tendenci/apps/imports/views.py:22-23, and the writer at tendenci/apps/imports/views.py:160 calls an undefined cPickle)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The imports user_upload_* views are a dead legacy flow (entry redirects to the profiles importer, writer references an undefined cPickle, superuser only, file lives in server storage), so the recap pickle looks unreachable and unrelated to the helpdesk saved-search report.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Ticket list builds a base64 JSON query (filtering/sorting/sortreverse/keyword/other_filter/search_string) into a hidden field that save_query must keep accepting; shared and own saved queries must still load in ticket_list and run_report and still be applied via apply_query's ORM filtering dict.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: SavedSearchForm checks only top-level keys; the nested 'filtering' dict keys and 'sorting' value from a saved query flow unchecked into queryset.filter(**{key: value}) / order_by in apply_query
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Not deserialization any more once JSON is used; ORM lookup injection looks like a different bug class (and the published fix also leaves it).
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different file (helpdesk/lib.py) from the view and form

O8_uncovered_routes.route: UserSettings.settings still pickle.loads base64 data from the DB on every helpdesk view that reads request.user.usersettings
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Only ever written server-side by pickle.dumps of form data (tendenci/apps/helpdesk/models.py:1032-1036); UserSettings is not exposed in the helpdesk admin, so no user-controlled bytes reach it.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: helpdesk/models.py, same package as landing point

O8b_injection_room.sibling: ticket_list could accept the encoded query directly (e.g. a ?query= b64 param) besides ?saved_query=, decoding it with the same loader
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The page already round-trips urlsafe_query (tendenci/apps/helpdesk/views/staff.py:866); a 'share this search link' feature reading it back is a natural maintainer addition.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a SavedSearch.get_query()/import-export helper or fixture loader that decodes query outside the views
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Model help_text still describes a pickled object; a model-level accessor is the idiomatic Django place for decoding and would sit outside the view the report points to.

O9_family: insecure deserialization (pickle) of stored user-supplied data; plus missing validation of saved search query structure

O10_build.project_tests: none found for helpdesk (no tendenci/apps/helpdesk/tests*); the fix adds no tests

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Swap the remaining helpdesk pickle.loads for json and stop, never touching save_query's unvalidated storage or the legacy imports recap loader.
